title: Decoding a configuration word
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$ whose work-tape heads and nonblank cells lie within distance $s$ of the origin. For either bit $b$, the action obtained by scanning the configuration block of the encoded word of $C$ and decoding its input-head position agrees with the effective action of $N$ on $C$ with transition bit $b$; the scanned block also recovers the head and output summary of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet
Every work-tape head position has absolute value at most $s$
Every work-tape cell at absolute position greater than $s$ is blank
